```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("_data.R")
man <- load_manifestos()
nb  <- length(REG$blocks)
nd  <- sum(map_int(REG$blocks, ~ length(.x$dims)))
```

::: {.hero}
# Populism, ideology and liberalism in `r format(nrow(man), big.mark = ",")` party manifestos

Three model families (Anthropic Claude Sonnet, OpenAI GPT-4.1-mini, Google Gemini Flash) score
every manifesto of the Manifesto Project corpus with full text, `r min(man$year)`–`r max(man$year)`.
Each score comes with the quote the model cited, and every page shows which evidence counted.

### Browse the manifestos

## Attribute blocks

```{r blocks, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
for (b in REG$blocks) cat(sprintf("- **%s** (%s): %d dimensions. %s\n", b$label, b$status, length(b$dims), b$description))
```

Further blocks, such as a party's environmental profile or its stance towards democratic
institutions, will be added to the same pages as they are scored.
